corrected_prompt:
STYLE: Stop-motion clay puppet scene - clay characters detailed with tiny craft materials: thread-wrapped hair, fabric details, wire accents, on a fully sculpted clay set, cinematic stop-motion film lighting with gentle shadows, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the puppet world. Palette: warm cream, terracotta and mustard clay with deep teal shadows, warm amber light; one bright subject against a calm, plain clay wall.

FORMAT AND LAYOUT: one vertical 9:16 image (portrait, 9 wide by 16 tall). Positions are fractions of the frame from the top-left corner. The top 30% of the frame is only plain clay wall, empty, kept clear for words added later. The post stack and the calendar page sit between 30% and 86% down, with the stack's base on the floor line at 86% down; below that line is only plain clay floor. Nothing important in the right 13% of the frame.

SUBJECT 1, THE POST STACK: on the left, standing on the floor, a tall, slightly leaning, uneven stack of about thirty square clay postcards, caught still in mid-wobble with no motion blur, from 30% to 86% down and from 10% to 42% across. Each card is a thin flat tile of cream clay with a stitched fabric edge and a small simple clay picture shape on its face (a sun, a cup, a plant), no words. The cards lie flat, one on top of another (not standing upright on their edges), stacked unevenly, each resting on the one below, the bottom card flat on the floor; their stitched edges show along the sides of the stack, and the stack leans just enough that the top cards tilt toward the camera so the small picture shapes on their faces show.
SUBJECT 2, THE EMPTY MONTH: on the right, one calendar month page sculpted from flat cream clay with a stitched fabric border and a stitched grid of empty day squares, held to the wall by a single clay pin, from 48% to 86% across and from 40% to 74% down. Every day square is empty.

SETTING: one plain warm cream clay wall fills the background, a plain clay floor meets the wall at 86% down; warm amber light from the upper left, gentle deep teal shadows low down. No window, shelf, desk or other objects. Camera at eye level with the middle of the stack. Wide-ish medium shot of the stack and the page together.

Must also not include: no figures or people; nothing on the calendar page.

HANDS: no human hands, fingers or arms anywhere in the picture.

TEXT: none. No text, letters, numbers or words anywhere in the picture: not on the calendar, the wall or any object. The calendar's day squares are empty stitched squares with no numbers, and there is no month name.

CAMERA: macro miniature-set look, about 50mm, shallow depth of field, the main subject sharp; the camera sits inside the miniature clay world.

DO NOT INCLUDE: no text, letters, numbers or words; no hearts, likes, thumbs-up, follower counts, notification badges, social media icons or logos; no real platform names, logos or app screens; no phone screens; no extra subjects beyond those named; no clutter in the top third; no smooth, glossy or CGI-looking surfaces; no motion blur; no borders, frames, split screens, set edges, workbench or the room around the miniature set.

Everything in frame is real modeling clay, photographed - visible fingerprints and tool marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
